description: Markup a Histos transfer profile carries, checked identically by Publish (packages/cms/src/transfer-markup.ts) and Histos on WordPress (plugin/src/Remote/TransferMarkup.php). Canonical copy in Publish; the builder keeps a byte-identical copy in plugin/tests/fixtures/.
rules: Reason codes are compared exactly; messages never are.
Grammars are compiled with the u flag in JavaScript and /uD in PHP; enum values compare after ASCII lower-casing of the decoded value; SVG grammars match the raw value exactly.

Element order: tag (G1), context (C1-C7), then each attribute in stored order: name syntax (G2), blocked names and form-only names (G4), blocked prefixes (G5), allowlist (HTML elements: elementAttributes of the tag, plus globalAttributes and the globalAttributePrefixes unless the tag is in elementsWithoutGlobalAttributes; SVG elements: svgAttributes of the tag, plus svgCommonAttributes, svgTextAttributes and every name that starts with one of svgAttributePrefixes and goes beyond it when the tag is in svgTagsWithCommonAttributes); SVG values: boolean or { } -> dynamic, & or \ -> value, grammar -> value, style (G7) -> style; HTML values: numeric references (G3) -> reference, value rule (static -> dynamic, enum/grammar/length -> value, srcset candidates -> url), URL attributes (G6) -> url, style (G7) -> style, form action/method (G9) -> form; finally form without action or method -> form, source without srcset -> attribute.
htmlValueRules keys are tag.attribute; *.attribute applies to the new HTML elements only. Every rule requires a static value.

svgValueRules keys are tag.attribute first, then attribute, then prefix* for a name of svgAttributePrefixes (aria-*, data-*). After its grammar, the style of an SVG element is checked by G7 on the raw value (it has no & and no backslash) -> style.

C7 (histos-svg-text-v1): tspan only under text or tspan; under text and tspan only tspan, title and desc; stop only under linearGradient or radialGradient, which hold only stop; nothing under stop. Tags are compared exactly: linearGradient and radialGradient are stored in this case. A site without the capability histos-svg-text-v1 is never sent svgTextTags, svgTextAttributes, an aria-* or data-* name outside svgCommonAttributes on an SVG element, or a fill or stroke that starts with url(.

G3: every &# must match grammars.numericReference with a code point in 0x20-0x7E or 0xA0-0x10FFFF, not a surrogate, not FDD0-FDEF, and not the last two code points of any plane. A named reference in legacyReferences after & and not followed by ;, = or an ASCII letter or digit is refused too (browsers decode it in attributes, PHP does not).

G6 on the decoded value: remove grammars.urlIgnored, ASCII lower-case, keep the part before {, no colon or a / ? # before it -> safe, else the scheme must be in urlSchemes. A srcset candidate may also be a strict histos-media:// identity. The href of an a may also be exactly a histos-media:// identity (raw value, lower-case uuid): a media file of the project (histos-media-links-v1).

G7: a style value with { or } is dynamic; on the decoded value, any /* is refused, then CR LF, CR and FF become LF and NUL becomes U+FFFD, then grammars.cssHexEscape (0, surrogates and > 0x10FFFF become U+FFFD) then grammars.cssCharEscape are resolved, ASCII lower-case, refuse a match of grammars.styleResource.
G9: a form endpoint with an @ in its authority (https://@host/) is refused even with empty userinfo; a relative path is never parsed as host:port.
Children kinds: element:<tag>, text, space (grammars.whitespace), verbatim, control (xb/if, xb/loop), component, slot.
Blocks: xb/component, xb/slot, xb/slot-fill and xb/passthrough are refused (context) inside svg and under contentBlockedParents.

Text: verbatim only under textarea and without grammars.verbatimForbidden; in svg only whitespace except under svgTextParents (title, desc, text, tspan); svgTextParents and option refuse < and apply G3; select, optgroup and picture only whitespace; elsewhere G3 then the inline markup scan (interpolations skipped, <! and <? refused, inlineTags with quoted static attributes, href through G6, balanced).

Branches (on the blocks as written, before any repair): xb/branch only in xb/if or as the {:else} of xb/loop, which is at most one branch, the loop's last named block, with no test attribute at all -> otherwise context. The {:else} does not see the loop variable or index.

Documents (import side): a non-empty src is exactly {props.<name>} or histos-media://<lower-case uuid> of an image asset; every srcset candidate of img and source is such an identity, referenced with path attrs.attributes.srcset and its index. The href of an a that is a histos-media:// identity names an image asset of the profile too, referenced with path attrs.attributes.href and no index. Markup and media are checked block by block in document order.

elements.note: menu icon with an accessible name
custom properties and states a style sheet selects
a gradient need not sit in defs
a paint server of the same document
only the canonical case is stored
tspan only in text or tspan
a line of text holds only text and tspan
a gradient holds only its stops
title and desc take no common attributes
a prefix alone is not a name
G7 on SVG: no url() in a style, a gradient goes in the fill attribute
no CSS escapes in an SVG value
the rule of the name wins over the prefix
a list of positions only on text and tspan
a paint server only in fill and stroke
only a fragment of the same document
lower-case viewbox: only the canonical case is stored
histos-svg-text-v1: a gradient of the same document
auto only on svg width/height and rx/ry
enums compare after lower-casing; value may be dynamic
dir is an enumeration on the new elements
the shape is valid; the media rule refuses it in a document
dir is an enumeration on the new elements only; data-* and aria-* stay open
C1 range: windows-1252 in browsers, undecoded in PHP
any /* is refused: inside a CSS string it starts no comment
a /* inside a CSS string hid url() from comment stripping
CR LF after a hex escape is one LF, which the escape consumes
an expression could bring url() at render time
a legacy named reference without ; decodes in browsers, not in PHP
followed by = a legacy reference is not decoded in an attribute
followed by a letter it is not decoded either
an empty userinfo is still userinfo
a relative path may contain a colon after the first segment
interest invokers open popovers by id
width and height may stay dynamic
microdata and translate are global attributes
a link to a media file of the project (histos-media-links-v1)

texts.note: a textarea is printed verbatim: no expressions
a tspan is an element, never markup in the text
</ a> is a bogus comment in the tokenizer: the link stays open
